# workflows

- `ci.yml` — fmt / check / clippy / test on Linux, Windows, macOS + Docker smoke test
- `release.yml` — **generated by cargo-dist** (`dist generate`); triggered by tag `v*`;
  builds archives + `install.sh` / `install.ps1` + checksums and publishes the GitHub Release.
  Never hand-edit; change `dist-workspace.toml` and regenerate instead.

Complementary GitHub config in `.github/`: `dependabot.yml` (dependency updates), `CODEOWNERS` (ownership).
